The misused VOLUME wrapper on 'Monita 8e Exempla politica' was retagged as TITLE. The single PRICE element was normalized to PRIZE. Unescaped ampersands in author/title text were changed to &. Encoding artefacts were restored as Bücher, Preiß, groß, mäßige, dagger separators (†), and ß as the Schilling abbreviation in prices. Original 18th-century/OCR title spellings were otherwise left unchanged.
